intent.proves: A product keeps two dated versions of one document and shows the earlier one in its history.
intent.scope: products whose source documentation lists several versions of one document

bindings.reason: DetailShowInHistory, DetailValidFrom and DetailValidTo exist (10.29.8 schema), but how the platform selects and renders a version history is not measured; no query may claim it yet.
